desc: Parse the \(N \times N\) adjacency-character matrix and store incoming/outgoing edges grouped by label.
Implement multi-source Dijkstra over ordered vertex-pair states with diagonal and direct-edge base cases.
Optimize matching-label transitions sufficiently for the \(N\le100\) constraints.
Verify correctness: each relaxation wraps a palindrome with equal labels, and every palindrome decomposes into a base case plus such wrappers.
Implement output formatting with \(-1\) for unreachable pairs.
